task: Figure out which parent-teacher conference slots to book first, before registration opens, based on how the kids are doing in school.
transcript: open: Home screen asked 'What can I help with?' with three example prompts and a note that nothing is sent without my OK.
type + tap Send: asked which conference slots to book first for Rafi, Ezra and Noa based on how each is doing; the button changed to 'Sending'.
wait 30: a thread titled 'Rank conference slots for the three kids' appeared with 'Your family school helper is on it' and 'Working on it'.

wait 30 x2: the answer arrived. Only Ezra's sign-up (Lincoln) was found, opening Sun Nov 15 at 7pm; book Mr. Brandt (Math, C+, 3 missing assignments) first, then Mr. Ruiz (Science, B, lab report not turned in), then optionally Ms. Okafor and Ms. Hale. Rafi: no conference email from Maple yet, ask Ms. Ortiz about reading fluency and 2 missing reading logs. Noa: no notice or reports found, asked for her school.
scroll down/up: read the whole answer; it ended by offering a reminder a few minutes before 7pm Sunday.
type 'yes please remind me sunday before 7' + Send, wait 30 x2: it replied 'Done. I'll remind you here Sun Nov 15 at 6:45pm' and said the reminder will list the order.

tap Details: 'What it looked at' listed the three school emails it read (conference sign-up notice, Ezra's and Rafi's progress reports), the words it searched for, that it checked my calendar, and the 6:45 PM reminder it set.
stumbles: The ranked list rendered as '1. 2. 3. and 4.': the third item reads 'and 4. Ms. Okafor...', which looks like a typo.
After the answer was done, the header still said 'Your family school helper is on it', so I was not sure if it was finished.
Noa got nothing; it asked for her school instead of guessing, which is honest but leaves a third of the task open.
Rafi's part says no conference email yet, so the 'book first' answer only really covers Ezra.
The bottom tab 'Workspace' and the 'Open the full workspace' link mean nothing to me.
verdict: One question got me a clear order for Ezra's slots with the reasons and real dates, an honest note that Rafi's and Noa's sign-ups were not in my email, and a reminder for Sunday, all in about three minutes. The Details page showed exactly which emails it read, which I trusted; the odd 'and 4.' list line and the 'still on it' header were the only rough spots.
